verses.2: Then David took the crown from the head of their king.
verses.3: David brought out the people who were there and put them to work
verses.4: Some time later, war broke out with the Philistines at Gezer. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai,
verses.5: Once again there was a battle with the Philistines, and Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother
verses.6: And there was also a battle at Gath, where there was a man of great stature with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot— twenty-four in all. He too was descended from Rapha,
verses.7: and when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of David’s brother Shimei killed him.
verses.8: So these descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David and his servants.
